sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel AbraMs.

sentences.en: Over the past few weeks, some of the most prestigious universities in the country have faced a threat to their very existence from President Trump,
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，国内一些最负盛名的大学面临着特朗普总统对其生存本身的威胁，

sentences.en: who has frozen billions of dollars in federal funds in an attempt to rid higher education of what he calls its woke ideology.
sentences.zh: 他冻结了数十亿美元的联邦资金，试图从高等教育中清除他所谓的“觉醒”意识形态。

sentences.en: And the question now is, who will cut a deal and who will fight?
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是，谁会妥协，谁会抗争？

sentences.en: Today, my conversation with the president of Princeton University,
sentences.zh: 今天，我与普林斯顿大学校长进行了交谈，

sentences.en: Christopher Eisgruber, who has vowed that he will fight.
sentences.zh: 他是克里斯托弗·艾斯格鲁伯，他发誓要抗争到底。

sentences.zh: 今天是4月9日，星期三。

sentences.en: Hi, Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 嗨，雷切尔·亚布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: Thanks for coming here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: Yes, thank you for making the time for us.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你为我们抽出时间。

sentences.zh: 你介意我去拿杯咖啡吗？

sentences.en: Please, no, no.

sentences.en: You should definitely have an ice.
sentences.zh: 你绝对应该来杯冰咖啡。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 我已经摄入咖啡因了，所以我得看看我们有没有摄入咖啡因。

sentences.en: No, good.
sentences.zh: 不，很好。

sentences.en: We like that energy on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢《每日新闻》的这种活力。

sentences.en: We're a high-energy show.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个充满活力的节目。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Terrific.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Come on back.
sentences.zh: 请进里面来。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: So, President Eisgruber, first of all, Eisgruber, right?
sentences.zh: 那么，艾斯格鲁伯校长，首先，叫艾斯格鲁伯对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, feel free to call me Chris, please.
sentences.zh: 对，请随意叫我克里斯。

sentences.en: Okay, Chris.
sentences.zh: 好的，克里斯。

sentences.en: It's easier than Eisgruber.
sentences.zh: 这比艾斯格鲁伯好叫多了。

sentences.en: Chris, we are talking to you about one week after the administration moved to suspend dozens of grants to Princeton, and that could be hundreds of millions of dollars potentially.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，我们在政府采取行动暂停对普林斯顿的数十项赠款大约一周后对你进行采访，这可能涉及数亿美元。

sentences.en: And this, of course, follows the moves from the administration against other universities.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是继政府对其他大学采取类似行动之后发生的。

sentences.en: We've seen it with Columbia.
sentences.zh: 我们在哥伦比亚大学看到了这一点。

sentences.en: We've seen it with Harvard.
sentences.zh: 我们在哈佛大学看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And if this goes the same way that it's gone for other institutions, what we could expect to see in the near future, if you haven't gotten it already,
sentences.zh: 如果这件事的发展轨迹和其他机构一样，如果我们还没收到的话，我们在不久的将来可能会看到的是，

sentences.en: is a list of demands from the Trump administration, changes that they want to see from Princeton.
sentences.zh: 来自特朗普政府的一系列要求，即他们希望普林斯顿做出的改变。

sentences.en: So, we want to talk to you today about how you're feeling about the choices that you have in front of you and what those choices even look like, practically speaking.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们今天想和你谈谈，你对摆在面前的选择有何感想，从实际角度来看，这些选择究竟是什么样的。

sentences.en: But just to start off, I want to start this conversation with you maybe taking us back to the moment when, if you remember, when you realized that Princeton
sentences.zh: 但首先，我想把这次对话拉回到你意识到普林斯顿

sentences.en: might actually be in trouble.
sentences.zh: 可能真的陷入麻烦的那个时刻（如果你还记得的话）。

sentences.en: Well, without trying to be precise right now about the timeline, we began to see precipitous kind of threats to funding streams early on in the new presidential administration.
sentences.zh: 嗯，虽然现在不想把时间线精确化，但我们在新政府上台之初，就开始看到资金来源受到急剧的威胁。

sentences.en: And that included initially a freeze to research funding to universities.
sentences.zh: 这最初包括冻结对大学的研究资助。

sentences.en: It included the imposition of severe caps on what are known as facilities and administration recoveries or overhead cost charges.
sentences.zh: 它包括对所谓的“设施和行政补偿”或间接成本费用设定严厉的上限。

sentences.en: Those are charges that apply to very real costs of research.
sentences.zh: 这些是适用于真实研究成本的费用。

sentences.en: And suddenly the government is saying, well, we're going to take that number down in ways that are going to make it impossible for universities to go forward with the research
sentences.zh: 突然之间，政府说，嗯，我们要把这个数字砍掉，这将使得大学无法继续进行

sentences.en: that they've been doing before.
sentences.zh: 他们以前一直在做的研究。

sentences.en: So, that was the point at which I and every other university president realized there was a serious threat to this government-university partnership
sentences.zh: 所以，正是在那个时间点，我和其他所有大学校长意识到，这个促进了国家实力和研究机构质量的政府与大学伙伴关系，遭到了严重的威胁。

sentences.en: that has contributed to the strength of the country and to the quality of our research institutions.
sentences.zh: 这不仅关乎我们的实力，也关乎我们研究机构的质量。

sentences.en: Then a couple of weeks ago, something happened at Columbia that introduced a new and in my view, very dangerous element to this, which is that the government came in
sentences.zh: 然后就在几周前，哥伦比亚大学发生了一件事，引入了一个在我看来非常危险的新因素，那就是政府介入了，

sentences.en: and without any due process or any apparent investigation, said basically to Columbia, we're going to take away a bunch of your grants that support things like medical research
sentences.zh: 在没有任何正当程序或明显调查的情况下，基本上对哥伦比亚大学说，我们要取消你们支持医学研究等项目的一大批赠款，

sentences.en: and we're not going to restore them to you unless you do things like admissions reform for how it is you take in undergraduate students and putting certain departments
sentences.zh: 除非你们采取诸如本科生招生改革之类的措施，并将某些

sentences.en: that deal with things like Middle Eastern studies into receivership.
sentences.zh: 处理中东研究等事务的部门置于接管之下，否则我们不会恢复这些资助。

sentences.en: That was whole new territory in terms of what the government was doing because the government was using its tremendous power over research dollars to try to control
sentences.zh: 就政府的所作所为而言，这是全新的一片领地，因为政府正在利用其对研究资金的巨大权力，来试图控制

sentences.en: what a private university was doing in terms of matters that are generally considered part of academic freedom.
sentences.zh: 一所私立大学在通常被认为属于学术自由范畴的事物上的行为。

sentences.en: That is how you constitute your departments, how you choose your students, and presumably how it is you choose your faculty.
sentences.zh: 也就是你如何组建你的部门，你如何选择你的学生，以及推而广之，你如何选择你的教职员工。

sentences.en: Of course, with Columbia, what the Trump administration said was that its motivation for pulling Columbia's funding was this failure to root out anti-Semitism on campus.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于哥伦比亚大学，特朗普政府给出的撤资动机是未能根除校园内的反犹太主义。

sentences.en: But in your mind, was that the motivation?
sentences.zh: 但在你看来，这就是动机吗？

sentences.en: Did that ring true to you?
sentences.zh: 这听起来真实吗？

sentences.en: And what did you understand that action by the administration to truly be about with regards to Columbia?
sentences.zh: 你认为政府对哥伦比亚大学采取这一行动的真正意图是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, Rachel, so let's start with this, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，雷切尔，所以让我们从这里开始，好吗？

sentences.en: Standing against anti-Semitism is a fundamental responsibility for any university president and for any university, it's something where universities
sentences.zh: 坚决反对反犹太主义是任何大学校长和任何大学的基本责任，这是大学

sentences.en: ought to be working in partnership with the government.
sentences.zh: 应当与政府合作去做的事情。

sentences.en: And if the government has concerns about anti-Semitism or any other form of hate on a college campus, it is legitimate for the government to go in pursuant to the laws
sentences.zh: 如果政府对大学校园里的反犹太主义或任何其他形式的仇恨感到担忧，政府根据

sentences.en: that exist prohibiting that.
sentences.zh: 现有的禁止此类行为的法律介入是合法的。

sentences.en: Title IX, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如《教育修正案第九条》。

sentences.en: Title IX, Title VI, right?
sentences.zh: 第九条，第六条，对吧？

sentences.en: And to come in to require the university to take steps.
sentences.zh: 介入并要求大学采取措施。

sentences.en: But that's the right way to proceed.
sentences.zh: 但这才是正确的前进方式。

sentences.en: In that kind of investigation, as in any other kind of investigation, the government should be observing the due process that our law provides.
sentences.zh: 在这种调查中，就像在任何其他调查中一样，政府应该遵守我们法律所规定的正当程序。

sentences.en: They should be allowing universities to respond and offer their side of the story.
sentences.zh: 他们应该允许大学做出回应并陈述他们的立场。

sentences.en: And then they should be putting in place, if they find that there are violations, appropriate remedies that are tailored to the violations and to the law.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果他们发现存在违规行为，他们应该实施针对违规行为和法律的适当补救措施。

sentences.en: I think the problem with what happened at Columbia was that due process was not observed.
sentences.zh: 我认为哥伦比亚大学事件的问题在于没有遵循正当程序。

sentences.en: The threats were made to funding without any real investigation or without any opportunity for Columbia to respond.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何真正的调查，也没有给哥伦比亚大学回应机会的情况下，资金受到了威胁。

sentences.en: And then they were done in ways that encroached on these extraordinarily important principles of academic freedom.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的做法侵犯了这些极其重要的学术自由原则。

sentences.en: From my own standpoint, as I look at Columbia, I would say it's clear there were some serious problems with anti-Semitism on that campus.
sentences.zh: 从我个人的角度来看，当我审视哥伦比亚大学时，我认为很明显，该校园存在一些严重的反犹太主义问题。

sentences.en: I also believe it's clear that Columbia was taking steps that they should be taking in order to address anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 我也相信很明显，哥伦比亚大学正在采取其应采取的步骤来解决反犹太主义问题。

sentences.en: If the government didn't think they were doing enough, that's a perfectly appropriate thing for the government to be involved in.
sentences.zh: 如果政府认为他们做得不够，那是政府参与其中的一个完全合理的切入点。

sentences.en: But again,
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，

sentences.en: respecting the norms of due process that are fundamental to our law and fundamental to our country, rather than doing this in some way that just comes in and says,
sentences.zh: 我们要尊重构成我们法律和国家基础的正当程序规范，而不是采取那种直接闯进来并说：

sentences.en: hey, we're taking your funds and now we want you to make these other kinds of changes.
sentences.zh: “嘿，我们要拿走你们的资金，现在我们要你们做出其他这些改变”的方式。

sentences.en: So basically, you're viewing all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，你在看待这一切。

sentences.en: I'm just going to narrate a little bit for us here.
sentences.zh: 我只是在这里为我们叙述一下。

sentences.en: You are seeing what's happening at Columbia.
sentences.zh: 你看到了哥伦比亚大学正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's when you decide to write this op-ed in The Atlantic, right?
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，你决定在《大西洋月刊》上写这篇专栏文章，对吧？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And you said that what the Trump administration is doing right now basically amounts to, quote, the greatest threat to American universities since the Red Scare of the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 你说特朗普政府现在的所作所为，基本上构成了“自20世纪50年代‘红色恐慌’以来对美国大学的最大威胁”。

sentences.en: Every American should be concerned.
sentences.zh: 每个美国人都应该对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: Can you tell us a little bit, why did you decide to write that op-ed and what did you mean by that quote specifically?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们讲讲吗，你为什么决定写那篇专栏文章，你这番话具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: So I decided to write the op-ed because I do think there's a very fundamental threat here right now with two dimensions to it to America's research universities
sentences.zh: 我决定写这篇专栏文章是因为我确实认为这里目前存在一个具有两个维度的非常根本的对美国研究型大学的威胁，

sentences.en: that anybody who cares about the strength of this country, our economy, our prosperity, our security, our health should be worried about.
sentences.zh: 任何关心这个国家的实力、我们的经济、我们的繁荣、我们的安全、我们的健康的人都应该为此感到担忧。

sentences.en: And one of those is the threat to this compact between the government and our universities that has produced research that's made a difference in the life of every American.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是对政府与我们大学之间这种契约的威胁，这种契约产生了改变了每个美国人生活的科研成果。

sentences.en: The reason I wrote when I did, when the threats were made to Colombia, is that there's an even more fundamental threat when the government starts intruding on academic freedom
sentences.zh: 我之所以选择在这个时候——当哥伦比亚大学受到威胁时——撰文，是因为当政府开始侵犯学术自由并

sentences.en: and basically says there are departments at Colombia that seem to be saying things that we don't like.
sentences.zh: 基本上说哥伦比亚大学有些部门似乎在说我们不喜欢的话时，存在着一个更加根本的威胁。

sentences.en: We're going to use this funding as a mechanism to try to change what it is Colombia is doing in that respect.
sentences.zh: 我们将利用这笔资金作为一种机制，试图改变哥伦比亚大学在这方面的做法。

sentences.en: That means as we look at efforts to influence what universities are doing, how they teach about Israel and Gaza, how they teach about climate, how they teach
sentences.zh: 这意味着当我们看到有人试图影响大学的行为、他们如何教授以色列和加沙、他们如何教授气候、他们如何教授

sentences.en: about American history, how they teach about diversity, we are seeing threats of significant intrusion into the freedom of scholars to raise the kinds of ideas that enable change
sentences.zh: 美国历史、他们如何教授多元化时，我们看到的是对学者自由的严重侵犯，这种自由本能让我们的社会发生变革

sentences.en: to take place in our society and enable people to pursue truth.
sentences.zh: 并使人们能够追求真理。

sentences.en: We see another version of this going on as the government goes in and gives an order, for example, to the United States
sentences.zh: 我们看到了这种现象的另一种版本，比如当政府介入并下令，例如向美国

sentences.en: Naval Academy to remove a whole series of books from its library.
sentences.zh: 海军学院下达命令，要求从其图书馆中移除整整一系列书籍。

sentences.en: There is a pattern here of intrusions in academic freedom of strong universities that should be of concern to every American.
sentences.zh: 这里存在一种侵犯强大大学学术自由的模式，这应该引起每个美国人的关注。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so basically to say this another way, the administration may have said that these actions that they're taking are about anti-Semitism and rooting that out on campus,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，政府可能已经说过他们采取这些行动是为了反犹太主义以及根除校园内的反犹太主义，

sentences.en: but it sounds like what you are saying and your point of view is that this is more about this broader beef the Trump administration has with institutions of higher education,
sentences.zh: 但听起来你的观点是，这更多关乎特朗普政府与高等教育机构之间更广泛的矛盾，

sentences.en: specifically with regards to academic freedom, the things that they are teaching and not teaching.
sentences.zh: 特别是关于学术自由，以及他们正在教授和没有教授的东西。

sentences.en: And that the government, it sounds like, again, correct me if I'm wrong here, but the government has this enormous leverage, which is research funding, and that is the cudgel
sentences.zh: 听起来政府——再次纠正我，如果我错了——拥有巨大的筹码，那就是研究资金，那是他们用来

sentences.en: with which that they can punish universities for speech or actions or conduct or academics that they do not like.
sentences.zh: 惩罚他们不喜欢的言论、行动、品行或学术界的“大棒”。

sentences.en: And so I just sort of wonder, would you agree with that, that this is more about academic freedom than maybe some of the other reasons that we have heard recently?
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想知道，你是否同意这一点，即这更多是关于学术自由，而不是我们最近听到的一些其他原因？

sentences.en: Yeah, Rachel, I don't want to make this about motive and what the government's motive or intentions are.
sentences.zh: 是的，雷切尔，我不想把这归结为动机以及政府的动机或意图是什么。

sentences.en: What I would say is if this is genuinely about anti-Semitism, there's a right way to go about that, right?
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，如果这真的是为了反对反犹太主义，那有一种正确的方法去处理它，对吧？

sentences.en: We should want our universities and our government to be partnering around making sure we have campuses where everybody can flourish.
sentences.zh: 我们应该希望我们的大学和政府合作，确保我们拥有一个让每个人都能蓬勃发展的校园。

sentences.en: And for me, that's about all the groups on my campus.
sentences.zh: 对我和我而言，这关乎我校园里的所有群体。

sentences.en: It's about our underrepresented minorities.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们代表性不足的少数族裔。

sentences.en: It's about our Jewish students.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们的犹太学生。

sentences.en: It's about our Muslim students.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们的穆斯林学生。

sentences.en: And we should all be working together around that.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都应该围绕这一点共同努力。

sentences.en: But there are right ways to do that.
sentences.zh: 但有正确的方法来做到这一点。

sentences.en: The wrong way of doing it does involve using funds as a cudgel to get universities to do things that the government wants.
sentences.zh: 错误的做法确实包括把资金当作大棒来逼迫大学去做政府想要的事情。

sentences.en: And when, for example,
sentences.zh: 举个例子，

sentences.en: I'll take one particular demand in the government's letter to Colombia.
sentences.zh: 我挑出政府给哥伦比亚大学信中的一个特定要求。

sentences.en: They asked Colombia to do comprehensive admission reform.
sentences.zh: 他们要求哥伦比亚大学进行全面的招生改革。

sentences.zh: 因此，这不仅在塑造学生的思维，而且在更广泛地塑造

sentences.en: American culture more broadly.
sentences.zh: 美国文化。

sentences.en: And that is why it is important to take a strong and aggressive stand.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么表明坚定和强硬立场如此重要。

sentences.en: I'm curious, what do you make of that argument, first of all?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，首先你如何看待这种论点？

sentences.en: And how important is it for a university to reflect the broader political ideologies of the country?
sentences.zh: 一所大学反映国家更广泛的政治意识形态有多重要？

sentences.en: Is it a problem that most universities are probably left of center?
sentences.zh: 大多数大学可能偏向中左翼，这是一个问题吗？

sentences.en: So, Rachel, there are a lot of different parts to that question you just asked.
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔，你刚才提出的问题包含很多不同的部分。

sentences.en: Let me start with where I think the truth is in the critique, right?
sentences.zh: 让我从我认为这种批评中符合事实的部分开始讲起。

sentences.en: So it is important for universities to have vigorous contestation about the truth and to make it possible for people of diverse viewpoints to express their opinions and to flourish
sentences.zh: 大学必须就真理展开激烈的争鸣，并为持不同观点的人创造条件，让他们能够在校园里表达意见并蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: on the campus.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们需要成为一个让保守派感到受欢迎的地方。

sentences.en: So we need to be a place where conservatives feel welcome.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要成为一个让保守派觉得他们能够畅所欲言的地方。

sentences.en: We also need to be a place where conservatives feel they can speak up.
sentences.zh: 我们需要成为这样一个地方：当有重要的保守派观点需要被倾听、当政治观点变得重要时，人们能够坚定地表达这些观点。

sentences.en: And we need to be a place where when there are important conservative arguments to be heard and when political viewpoints matter, people are asserting those.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为大学在这方面可以做得更好。

sentences.en: And I do think universities can do better about that.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，当我们谈论言论自由时，我们必须谈论倾听多种观点的重要性，我们应该对此予以关注，因为这与我们的

sentences.en: That is, when we're talking about free speech, we have to talk about the importance of having multiple viewpoints heard and we should care about that because it's integral
sentences.zh: 核心使命以及我们在教育和研究中努力实现的目标密不可分。

sentences.en: to our own mission and what we're trying to do in education and research.
sentences.zh: 这与声称大学应该反映国家的政治意识形态是两码事。

sentences.en: That's different from saying that universities should reflect the political ideology of the country.
sentences.zh: 实际上我们不应该这么做，对吧？

sentences.en: We shouldn't, actually, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不应该。

sentences.en: We shouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该。

sentences.en: We shouldn't.
sentences.zh: 反映国家的政治意识形态不是我们的工作，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not our job to reflect the political ideology of the country, right?
sentences.zh: 我们不是那种拥有意识形态平衡的周日早间脱口秀节目。

sentences.en: We're not a Sunday morning talk show that has ideological balance on it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要对保守派观点保持开放。

sentences.en: We need to be open to conservative views.
sentences.zh: 我们需要成为一个让保守派感到能够蓬勃发展的地方。

sentences.en: We need to be a place where conservatives feel they can flourish.
sentences.zh: 但我们应该做的事情有所不同，而不仅仅是反映国家正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: But we're supposed to be doing something different than just reflecting what's going on in the country.
sentences.zh: 我们应该开展旨在探求真理和知识的辩论，这与政治辩论会是不同的。

sentences.en: We're supposed to be having arguments that get at truth and knowledge and that's different from a political debating society.
sentences.zh: 它不同于国会中发生的事情，也不同于许多新闻报道或国内政治分布的情况。

sentences.en: It's different from what goes on in Congress and it's different from what goes on in a lot of journalism or from the political distribution in the country.
sentences.zh: 目前在气候和疫苗等问题上存在政治分歧，大学没有义务去反映这些主题上国内舆论的政治分歧

sentences.en: There are political divisions about things like climate and vaccines right now and there is no obligation on the part of the universities to reflect what is the political
sentences.zh: ，或者关于资本主义和投资的讨论。

sentences.en: division of opinion on those subjects or about, say, capitalism and investing.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解你的意思，比如你不想为那些你所不信的理念提供发声平台，例如关于气候变化的不科学言论，但我确信你

sentences.en: I totally hear you that, like, you don't want to platform ideas that you don't believe in such as bad science around climate change but I'm sure you can
sentences.zh: 也能理解保守派听到你刚才那番话时，为什么会认为他们的观点在校园里可能不如其他观点受欢迎。

sentences.en: understand how conservatives might hear what you just said and think that their viewpoints are not necessarily as welcome as other viewpoints on campus.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗·鲁福（Christopher Rufo），

sentences.en: Christopher Ruffo,
sentences.zh: 我确信你对他也非常熟悉，他一直在推行许多政府现在似乎正在采纳的理念，以此来对高等教育进行猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: I'm sure you're familiar with him, he has been pushing a lot of the ideas that the administration is now using, it seems, to make this broadside against higher education.
sentences.zh: 多年来他一直在争辩说，大学过于“觉醒”（woke），多元、公平与包容（DEI）是个问题。

sentences.en: He's been arguing for years that universities are too, quote-unquote, woke, that DEI is a problem.
sentences.zh: 你在刚才谈到时，让我想起了他说过的一句话。

sentences.en: He said something that I'm thinking of as you're talking right now.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果保守派想要保护美国的生活方式，他们就必须愿意围攻这些机构，并根据他们自己的价值观对其进行重新定位。

sentences.en: He said, if conservatives want to protect the American way of life, they must be willing to lay siege to the institutions and reorient them according to their own values.
sentences.zh: 很显然，像鲁福这样的人——而且显然有一些有权势的人在听取他的意见——认为你刚才阐述的还远远不够，这就是政府采取如此激进态度的原因。

sentences.en: Clearly, people like Ruffo and clearly he's got some powerful people who are listening to him are thinking that what you just articulated is not enough and that is the reason
sentences.zh: 所以我只是在想，基本上，你是否需要重新思考你刚才对我说的话？

sentences.en: why the administration is taking such an aggressive approach.
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔，我认为我需要坚持我在刚才的讲话中做出的区分，那就是：在校园里欢迎保守派观点非常重要，

sentences.en: And so I just wonder, like, do you need to rethink what you just told me, basically?
sentences.zh: 但这与在校园里强求意识形态平衡是完全不同的。

sentences.en: Now, Rachel, I think I need to insist on a distinction that I drew in what I just told you, which is that it's really important for conservative views to be welcome on a campus,
sentences.zh: 听着，雷切尔，我认为我需要坚持刚才我所做的区分，那就是保守派观点在校园里受欢迎非常重要，

sentences.en: but that's different from insisting on ideological balance on a campus.
sentences.zh: 但这与坚持校园内的意识形态平衡是两回事。

sentences.en: Our job is to have an honest, fair, truth-seeking process, right?
sentences.zh: 我们的工作是进行一个诚实、公平、寻求真相的过程，对吧？

sentences.en: And an honest, fair, truth-seeking process will produce criticisms of society.
sentences.zh: 而一个诚实、公平、寻求真相的过程将会产生对社会的批判。

sentences.en: It won't just be a mirror to society, so that's a difference.
sentences.zh: 它不只是社会的镜子，这就是区别所在。

sentences.en: There's a second thing you said in your original question that also connects to what it is that you just asked about Christopher Rufo.
sentences.zh: 你在最初的问题中提到的第二点，也跟你刚刚问到的关于克里斯托弗·鲁福（Christopher Rufo）的事有关。

sentences.en: You quoted some accusations that universities indoctrinate.
sentences.zh: 你引用了一些关于大学进行洗脑的指控。

sentences.en: Universities should never be indoctrinating, right?
sentences.zh: 大学绝不应该进行洗脑，对吧？

sentences.en: And I don't think we are and I don't think that the opinion data or the other serious studies of what universities do supports that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们没有这样做，我也认为民意数据或其他关于大学行为的严肃研究不支持这种说法。

sentences.en: We've got to be places where robust arguments take place.
sentences.zh: 我们必须成为能够进行有力辩论的地方。

sentences.en: I think what one has to understand is colleges and universities are going to be,
sentences.zh: 我认为人们必须要理解的是，学院和大学将要——

sentences.en: I'm going to quote one of my predecessors, in my office,
sentences.zh: 我要引用我的一位前任、我办公室的前辈的话——

sentences.en: Bill Bowen, they're going to be at a slight angle to society.
sentences.zh: 比尔·鲍恩（Bill Bowen）的话，他们将与社会保持微小的倾角。

sentences.en: They operate pursuant to a different set of principles,
sentences.zh: 他们按照一套不同的原则运作，

sentences.en: scholarly disciplines that provide scholarly standards for how you judge arguments that are different from what exists in the rest of society.
sentences.zh: 即提供学术标准的研究学科，用于判断论点，这与社会其他地方存在的标准不同。

sentences.en: So we shouldn't expect them just to be mirrors to what society is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不应该期望它们仅仅成为社会现状的镜子。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·刘（Wena Liu）。

sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏部的

sentences.en: Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies, I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 《连线》（Connections）谜题，我喜欢恐怖电影，喜欢我的狗，还喜欢捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 《拼字蜜蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《字母宝箱》（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色听联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的人这样的一群人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: I want to go back to the storytelling for a moment and go back to Columbia, which capitulated pretty quickly to what the administration wanted.
sentences.zh: 我想暂时回到叙事上来，回到哥伦比亚大学，它对校方想要的东西迅速做出了妥协。

sentences.en: And I want to get your reaction to that, but I also want to read you a quote that you gave, I believe it was to PBS, when Columbia was sort of in the midst of all of this.
sentences.zh: 我想听听你对此的反应，但我也想读一段你曾说过的话，如果我没记错的话，那是对公共广播电视公司（PBS）说的，当时哥伦比亚大学正处于这一切的混乱之中。

sentences.en: You said, once you make concessions once, it's hard not to make them again.
sentences.zh: 你说过，一旦你做出过妥协，就很难不再做出妥协。

sentences.en: So I'd like to know, did what Columbia did make your job harder, as you're now trying to figure out how to deal with the administration.
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，哥伦比亚大学的做法是否让你的工作变得更难了，因为你现在正试图找出如何与校方打交道。

sentences.en: And are you talking to other university presidents to try to come up with some kind of a united front, much in the way that we're seeing some of the law firms that are under fire
sentences.zh: 你是否也在与其他大学校长交谈，试图建立某种统一战线，就像我们看到的一些遭到抨击的律师事务所那样——

sentences.en: talking to each other to try to stand up for each other and present a united front?
sentences.zh: 互相交流以试图捍卫彼此并建立统一战线？

sentences.en: Yeah, so, you know, let me start with this, right, which is that the circumstances right now that face any university president are really tremendously difficult circumstances.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以，你知道，让我从这一点开始，对吧，那就是任何大学校长目前面临的环境确实是极其困难的环境。

sentences.en: And I say that because I don't want to underestimate in any way the difficulty of the choices that my counterpart at Columbia faced.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因为我不想在任何方面低估我在哥伦比亚大学的同行所面临的选择的难度。

sentences.en: I believe it's important and essential to stand up for academic freedom, but the threats to an institution that are coming when the government says it's going to deprive
sentences.zh: 我认为站出来捍卫学术自由是重要且至关重要的，但当政府表示要剥夺——

sentences.en: that institution of federal funding are severe in a way that present really hard choices.
sentences.zh: 该机构的联邦经费时，对一个机构的威胁是严重的，这带来了极其艰难的选择。

sentences.en: Presidents are talking to one another about this.
sentences.zh: 校长们正在就此进行交流。

sentences.en: As I chair the board for the Association of American Universities, board meetings occur regularly.
sentences.zh: 由于我担任美国大学协会（Association of American Universities）董事会主席，董事会会议定期举行。

sentences.en: Now, they used to be twice a year.
sentences.zh: 以前，这些会议是一年两次。

sentences.en: They're considerably more often.
sentences.zh: 现在要频繁得多。

sentences.en: What does regularly mean?
sentences.zh: 定期是什么意思？

sentences.en: It's needed every one or two weeks or so.
sentences.zh: 大约每隔一两周就需要开一次。

sentences.en: Because you're viewing this as a crisis.
sentences.zh: 因为你认为这是一场危机。

sentences.en: It is a crisis, right?
sentences.zh: 这确实是一场危机，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, the funding that is essential to the quality of American research and America's universities is under threat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对美国研究质量和美国大学至关重要的资金正受到威胁。

sentences.en: That's a crisis for universities and it is a crisis for our country.
sentences.zh: 这对大学来说是一场危机，对我们的国家来说也是一场危机。

sentences.en: We each have our own missions and our own needs so our responses are not necessarily going to be identical to one another.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有自己的使命和自己的需求，所以我们的反应不一定完全相同。

sentences.en: But I will say this, I think even when universities have to concede or make concessions because they may be forced to do that in order to protect people,
sentences.zh: 但我会说，我认为即使大学不得不让步或做出妥协，因为为了保护人们他们可能被迫这样做，

sentences.en: I think they need to speak up under those circumstances and recognize the principles at stake.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们在这种情况下需要大声说出来，并认识到所涉及的原则。

sentences.en: Even if they say something like, I really regret this but I need under these circumstances to make a compromise.
sentences.zh: 即使他们说类似这样的话：我对此深表遗憾，但在此情况下我需要做出妥协。

sentences.en: Do you wish you had heard that from Columbia?
sentences.zh: 你希望自己当时也能从哥伦比亚大学听到这样的话吗？

sentences.en: I do wish I had heard that from Columbia, right?
sentences.zh: 我确实希望当时能从哥伦比亚大学听到这样的话，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I just think I understand why Columbia might feel that they had to make concessions under the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只是觉得我理解为什么哥伦比亚大学在那种情况下会觉得他们不得不做出妥协。

sentences.en: These choices are so hard, right?
sentences.zh: 这些选择太艰难了，对吧？

sentences.en: You have careers at stake.
sentences.zh: 你的职业生涯危在旦夕。

sentences.en: You have jobs at stake.
sentences.zh: 你的工作危在旦夕。

sentences.en: You have the ability to educate your students at stake and you may say, look, I wish I could take a stand on principle but given what's at stake, I can't.
sentences.zh: 你教育学生的能力危在旦夕，你可能会说，听着，我希望我能坚守原则，但鉴于事关重大，我做不到。

sentences.en: But then you need to say that, right?
sentences.zh: 但随后你需要说出来，对吧？

sentences.en: You need to admit and you need to say to your community and to Americans, hey, there's something really fundamental that has been lost here.
sentences.zh: 你需要承认，并向你的社区和美国人说，嘿，这里有些非常根本的东西已经失去了。

sentences.en: Does this mean that you are considering making concessions to the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着你正在考虑向特朗普政府做出妥协？

sentences.en: I'm not considering any concessions.
sentences.zh: 我没有考虑任何妥协。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 绝不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: Look, we haven't been asked for anything,
sentences.zh: 听着，我们什么都没被要求，

sentences.en: Rachel.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔（Rachel）。

sentences.en: Right now, all the Trump administration has said to us and all the, actually, the funding agencies have said to us is that the grants are being suspended.
sentences.zh: 目前，特朗普政府对我们所说的一切，实际上，资助机构对我们所说的一切，都是这些赠款正在被暂停。

sentences.en: In general, there are a small number of cancellations but in general they've said that they've been suspended pending a period of time during which the administration
sentences.zh: 总的来说，有一小部分被取消了，但总的来说他们表示这些赠款已被暂停，在一段时间内等待政府——

sentences.en: is determining whether or not the grants are in accordance with law.
sentences.zh: 裁定这些赠款是否符合法律规定。

sentences.en: So they haven't asked us to do anything.
sentences.zh: 所以他们并没有要求我们做任何事情。

sentences.en: But you likely will.
sentences.zh: 但你们很可能会被要求。

sentences.en: This is anything like the other universities.
sentences.zh: 这就像其他大学一样。

sentences.en: They're probably going to be sending you some sort of a liSt.
sentences.zh: 他们可能很快会给你们发来某种名单。

sentences.en: Rachel, I don't know the answer to that question and I won't speculate about it but I believe it is essential for us to protect academic freedom.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔，我不知道那个问题的答案，我不会对此进行推测，但我相信保护学术自由对我们至关重要。

sentences.en: Okay, so let me just ask you specifically, like, let's just say that tomorrow the Trump administration says, we want to put your, I don't know if you have a Middle Eastern
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我具体问你一个问题，比如说，假设明天特朗普政府说，我们希望把你们的——我不知道你们是否有中东——

sentences.en: Studies department but we want to put one of your departments under academic receivership or you don't get your money.
sentences.zh: 研究系，但我们希望将你们的一个系置于学术接管之下，否则你们就拿不到资金。

sentences.en: What do you do?
sentences.zh: 你会怎么做？

sentences.en: We would not do that.
sentences.zh: 我们不会那样做。

sentences.en: We believe that that would be unlawful and we would contest that in court.
sentences.zh: 我们认为那是违法的，我们会在法庭上对簿公堂。

sentences.en: Which means potentially losing your funding, of course, from the government as we've discussed.
sentences.zh: 这意味着可能会失去政府的资金支持，正如我们刚才讨论的那样。

sentences.en: I mean, I just sort of wonder, like, if you're willing to do battle over some of the demands that one might reasonably expect are coming, have you guys modeled how long
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只是在想，如果你愿意为了人们可以合理预期的某些即将到来的要求而战，你们是否模拟过在没有政府支持的情况下，作为现在的普林斯顿大学，

sentences.en: you could last financially without the government's support as Princeton as is now?
sentences.zh: 你们在财务上能坚持多久？

sentences.en: Rachel, I mean, right now we are facing a variety of different threats to our funding model.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔，我的意思是，目前我们的资助模式正面临着各种不同的威胁。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, because I think this needs to be there for me to answer your question, there's the kind of risk that you just mentioned.
